# Operator fixtures

Frozen, fixture-local operator inputs for `tests/test_operator.py`: sample
`providers.d` declarations (T2 providers `acme`, `beta`, `lanbox`; lines-only
files on the fixture catalog's `kimi`, `anthropic` and `openai` providers), a
legacy `custom.json` for the migration preflight, an empty ledger and a sample
evidence document. No shipped model id appears here; wires are invented.
